fixed.summary: Components that leaned on React Native's flex defaults lay out under CSS's: racing Results' standings column stretches to its grid row, so a long list scrolls above Retry and Continue instead of under them; Table's figure cells align right and every cell centres in its row; Daily quests' bar sits beside its count with no wrapper. Racing Results' player position reads 2nd, 3rd, 11th and so on, not 2th.
